<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 99.1</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><IMG SRC="image_001.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>S&amp;P Global Announces Approval of Separation
of Mobility Global</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">NEW
YORK, May 21, 2026 <B>- </B>S&amp;P Global Inc. (NYSE: SPGI)</FONT> (&ldquo;S&amp;P Global&rsquo;&rsquo;) today announced that its Board of Directors
(the &ldquo;Board&rdquo;) has approved the previously announced separation of its Mobility division, and the creation of an independent,
public company, Mobility Global Inc.&nbsp;(&ldquo;Mobility Global&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The separation will be achieved
through a&nbsp;pro rata&nbsp;distribution of 100% of the outstanding shares of Mobility Global common stock to the holders of S&amp;P
Global common stock. S&amp;P Global shareholders will receive one share of Mobility Global common stock for every share of S&amp;P Global
common stock held at the close of business on the record date of&nbsp;June 15, 2026&nbsp;(the &ldquo;record date&rdquo;). The distribution
of Mobility Global shares is expected to be effective at 12:01 a.m. New York City time on July 1, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The holders of S&amp;P Global
common stock entitled to receive the distribution will receive a book-entry account statement or a credit to their brokerage account reflecting
their ownership of Mobility Global common stock. No action is required by S&amp;P Global shareholders to receive Mobility Global shares
in the distribution.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Fractional shares of Mobility
Global common stock will not be distributed. Any fractional share of Mobility Global common stock otherwise issuable to a holder of S&amp;P
Global common stock will be sold in the open market on such shareholder&rsquo;s behalf, and such shareholder will receive a cash payment
for the fractional share based on its&nbsp;pro rata&nbsp;portion of the net cash proceeds from all sales of fractional shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Prior to the distribution, S&amp;P
Global expects to deliver an information statement to all shareholders entitled to receive the distribution. The information statement
will describe Mobility Global, including the risks of owning Mobility Global common stock and other details regarding the separation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The completion of the distribution
is subject to a number of customary conditions, including that Mobility Global&rsquo;s registration statement on Form 10 shall have been
declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission and that no determination will have been made by the Board that it is inadvisable
to proceed with the distribution.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">S&amp;P Global expects that
a &ldquo;when-issued&rdquo; public trading market for Mobility Global common stock will commence on or about&nbsp;June 26, 2026&nbsp;under
the symbol &ldquo;MBGL WI,&rdquo; and will continue through June 30, 2026. S&amp;P Global also anticipates that &ldquo;regular-way&rdquo;
trading of Mobility Global common stock will begin on&nbsp;July 1, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Beginning on or about&nbsp;June
26, 2026, and through June 30, 2026, it is expected that there will be two ways to trade S&amp;P Global common stock &ndash; either with
or without the distribution of Mobility Global common stock. S&amp;P Global shareholders who sell their shares of S&amp;P Global common
stock in the &ldquo;regular-way&rdquo; market (that is, the normal trading market under the symbol &ldquo;SPGI&rdquo;) after June 26,
2026 and on or prior to June 30, 2026 will be selling their right to receive shares of Mobility Global common stock in connection with
the separation. Alternatively, S&amp;P Global shareholders who sell their shares of S&amp;P Global common stock in the &ldquo;ex-distribution&rdquo;
market during the same period under the symbol &ldquo;SPGI WI&rdquo; will not be selling their right to receive shares of Mobility Global
common stock in connection with the separation. Investors are encouraged to consult with their financial advisors regarding the specific
implications of buying or selling shares of S&amp;P Global common stock on or before June 30, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Following the distribution,
Mobility Global will be an independent, public company. Mobility Global expects to receive authorization to list its common stock on the
New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol &ldquo;MBGL&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Goldman Sachs &amp; Co. LLC&nbsp;and&nbsp;Morgan
Stanley &amp; Co. LLC&nbsp;are serving as financial advisors and&nbsp;Davis Polk &amp; Wardwell LLP&nbsp;is serving as legal counsel to
S&amp;P Global.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>About S&amp;P Global</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global (NYSE: SPGI) enables businesses, governments, and individuals
with trusted data, expertise and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading
benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive in a rapidly changing global
landscape.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">From helping
our customers assess new investments across the capital and commodities markets to navigating the energy expansion, acceleration of artificial
intelligence, and evolution of public and private markets, we enable the world&rsquo;s leading organizations to unlock opportunities,
solve challenges, and plan for tomorrow &ndash; today.</FONT> Learn more at <B>www.spglobal.com.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Investor Relations: <B>https://investor.spglobal.com</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>About Mobility Global </U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Mobility Global
is the world&rsquo;s standard for mobility intelligence, providing critical data and analytics across the full vehicle lifecycle. Its
portfolio of trusted brands and products includes CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Polk Automotive Solutions, and Market Scan, supporting
the world&rsquo;s major automakers, suppliers, dealer groups, media, financial institutions, and consumers with data, forecast, insights,
technology, and innovation. </FONT>Additional information about the planned separation is available at <B>https://investor.spglobal.com.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

statements,&rdquo; as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These statements, which express management&rsquo;s
current views concerning future events, trends, contingencies or results, appear at various places in this press release and use words
like &ldquo;anticipate,&rdquo; &ldquo;assume,&rdquo; &ldquo;believe,&rdquo; &ldquo;continue,&rdquo; &ldquo;estimate,&rdquo; &ldquo;expect,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;forecast,&rdquo; &ldquo;future,&rdquo; &ldquo;intend,&rdquo; &ldquo;plan,&rdquo; &ldquo;potential,&rdquo; &ldquo;predict,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;project,&rdquo; &ldquo;strategy,&rdquo; &ldquo;target&rdquo; and similar terms, and future or conditional tense verbs like &ldquo;could,&rdquo;
 &ldquo;may,&rdquo; &ldquo;might,&rdquo; &ldquo;should,&rdquo; &ldquo;will&rdquo; and &ldquo;would.&rdquo; For example, management may
use forward-looking statements when addressing topics such as: the outcome of contingencies; future actions by regulators; changes in
the business strategies and methods of generating revenue of S&amp;P Global Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;); the development and performance
of the Company&rsquo;s services and products; the expected impact of acquisitions and dispositions; the Company&rsquo;s effective tax
rates; the Company&rsquo;s cost structure, dividend policy, cash flows or liquidity; and the anticipated separation of S&amp;P Global
Mobility (&ldquo;Mobility&rdquo;) into a standalone public company.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the Company&rsquo;s ability to make acquisitions and dispositions and successfully integrate the businesses
we acquire;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">consolidation of the Company&rsquo;s customers, suppliers or competitors;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the ability of the Company, and its third-party service providers, to maintain adequate physical and technological
infrastructure;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the Company&rsquo;s ability to successfully recover from a disaster or other business continuity problem,
such as an earthquake, hurricane, flood, civil unrest, protests, military conflict, terrorist attack, outbreak of pandemic or contagious
diseases, security breach, cyber attack, data breach, power loss, telecommunications failure or other natural or man-made event;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the impact on the Company&rsquo;s revenue and net income caused by fluctuations in foreign currency exchange
rates;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the impact of changes in applicable tax or accounting requirements on the Company;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the separation of Mobility not being consummated within the anticipated time period or at all;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the ability of the separation of Mobility to qualify for tax-free treatment for U.S. federal income tax
purposes;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">any disruption to the Company&rsquo;s business in connection with the proposed separation of Mobility;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">any loss of synergies from separating the businesses of Mobility and the Company that adversely impact
the results of operations of both businesses, or the companies resulting from the separation of Mobility not realizing all of the expected
benefits of the separation; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">following the separation of Mobility, the combined value of the common stock of the two publicly-traded
companies not being equal to or greater than the value of the Company&rsquo;s common stock had the separation not occurred.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0in">The factors noted above are not exhaustive. The Company
and its subsidiaries operate in a dynamic business environment in which new risks emerge frequently. Accordingly, the Company cautions
readers not to place undue reliance on any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the dates on which they are made. The Company
undertakes no obligation to update or revise any forward-looking statement to reflect events or circumstances arising after the date on
which it is made, except as required by applicable law. Further information about the Company&rsquo;s businesses, including information
about factors that could materially affect its results of operations and financial condition, is contained in the Company&rsquo;s filings
with the SEC, including Item 1A, <I>Risk Factors</I> in our most recently filed Annual Report on Form 10-K.</P>
